rows.title: Extension feels slow
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. Could you share the steps that trigger the lag, the file type and approximate size (lines or KB), and whether it happens in every file or only particular ones? Please also include your Note Stats and VS Code versions, OS, and whether you're using desktop VS Code or vscode.dev. Does the lag persist with all other extensions disabled and only Note Stats enabled, and does disabling Note Stats make it go away?
rows.verifyEvidence: Reporter isn't sure Note Stats is the cause. Its only per-keystroke work, a linear computeStats(getText()) in src/extension.ts, is cheap, so file size and an extension-bisect result are needed to show a real defect.

rows.title: Count only the selection when text is selected
Command to copy the current stats to the clipboard
Add a line and paragraph count
Make Note Stats work on vscode.dev as a web extension
Word count counts numbers as words
Is there a keyboard shortcut for Insert Timestamp?
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for asking. Note Stats does not provide a default shortcut for Insert Timestamp. Run **Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts**, search for **Note Stats: Insert Timestamp**, then select its edit-keybinding action and enter your preferred shortcut. If you edit `keybindings.json` directly, use the command ID `noteStats.insertTimestamp`.

rows.title: Doesn't work
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. What did you expect to appear, and what steps did you take after installing Note Stats? If you mean the word count, does it remain missing from the status bar with a text file open and focused? The item hides when no editor is active. Please also check whether “Note Stats: Toggle Status Bar Item” appears in the Command Palette and whether running it helps. Which Note Stats and VS Code versions are you using, on which OS, and is this desktop VS Code or vscode.dev?
rows.verifyEvidence: The report says only “nothing shows up.” It doesn't say what was expected, which editor or file state applied, or which steps were taken, and the status bar item hides by design when no editor is active.

Slugify leaves a trailing hyphen and drops accented letters
Status bar item does not hide when the last editor is closed
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. I couldn't reproduce this by tracing the close-last-editor flow in current main: `refresh()` hides the item and returns when no editor is active, and the document-change handler cannot show it again in that state. Closing as not reproducible for now. If it happens again, please share the screen recording you offered, your Note Stats and VS Code versions, and your OS so we can investigate what differs from this flow.

rows.title: Add spell checking to Note Stats
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the suggestion. Note Stats deliberately focuses on text statistics and small markdown helpers; spell checking and prose corrections are explicitly outside its scope, including with a bundled offline dictionary. The scope is documented in https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/blob/main/vision.md#out-of-scope. Closing this as out of scope; a separate spell-checking extension is the better fit for underlines and correction quick fixes.

rows.title: Copy stats button

noteStats.timestampFormat is ignored, Insert Timestamp always inserts ISO
Show estimated reading time next to the word count
Status bar item does not hide when the last editor is closed
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the detailed report. I traced this flow on current `main`: when the active editor becomes undefined, `refresh()` calls `statusItem.hide()` and returns. The document-change listener also cannot show it again at that point because it only refreshes when its document matches the active editor. I couldn't reproduce the stale item from the current code path, so I suggest closing this as not reproducible. If it happens again, a short screen recording together with the Note Stats version, VS Code version, OS, and whether this is desktop or vscode.dev would help identify an environment-specific event sequence.

rows.title: Add spell checking to Note Stats
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the suggestion. Spell checking and correction suggestions are outside Note Stats' documented scope: the extension measures text and provides small insertion helpers, but it does not check, judge, or correct prose. The project direction explicitly leaves spell checking and language-specific writing assistance to dedicated extensions: https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/blob/main/vision.md. Closing this as out of scope.

rows.title: Word count is wrong when words are separated by more than one space
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the clear report. This is confirmed on current `main`: `computeStats` splits on a literal single space, so `one  two` creates an empty token, while newlines are not handled as word separators. The README specifies whitespace-separated counting matching `wc -w`, so this should stay open as a correctness bug with regression coverage for repeated spaces and blank-line-separated paragraphs.

rows.title: Character count setting not applied
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. This is the same issue tracked in https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/4: `noteStats.showCharacters` is read when the extension activates, so enabling it does not update the status bar until a reload or restart. Closing this as a duplicate of that older report; your confirmation that restarting VS Code makes the character count appear matches its reload workaround.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both report the same thing: turning on the show-characters setting leaves the status bar unchanged until VS Code reloads or restarts. B traces this to the setting being read only once at activation in src/extension.ts.

rows.title: Reading time estimate
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the suggestion. Reading-time estimates are already requested in https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/8, including how to display them and handle short documents. Closing this as a duplicate of that older request; your reference to Medium is useful context for the presentation discussion there.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both ask for the same capability: show an estimated reading time for the document. A's one-line "like Medium" request is fully covered by B's status-bar "~3 min read" proposal.

rows.title: Word count off with double spaces
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. This is the same repeated-space counting defect tracked in https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/30, so we're closing this report as a duplicate of that older issue. Your additional example—three spaces adding two extra words—and the Note Stats 0.1.0 / VS Code 1.140 versions are useful supporting details. The intended behavior is to count whitespace-separated words without counting the extra spaces.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both report the status bar word count going up by one for each extra space between words. That points to one root cause: computeStats splits on a single space. B also covers newlines, but A loses nothing if closed in B's favor.

rows.title: Selection word count please
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the request. This is already tracked in https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/10, which asks for the status bar to count selected text and return to the whole-document count when the selection is cleared. Your highlighted-paragraph example is the same use case, so we're closing this as a duplicate and keeping that request together there. Selection-based counts are not implemented yet.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both items ask for the same thing: the status bar word count should cover only the selected text, not the whole document. B's ask contains A's exactly, and B adds multi-cursor and 'X of Y' details.

rows.title: Copy stats button

rows.verifyEvidence: Both ask for one capability: a command that copies the current word and character counts to the clipboard as text for pasting. A's 'button or command' is met by B's Note Stats: Copy Stats command.

Char count broken
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report and the second-machine update. This matches https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/4: Note Stats reads `noteStats.showCharacters` when it activates, so enabling it afterward does not take effect until a reload. Characters can appear immediately when the setting is already enabled at activation, so the second-machine result does not rule out the same bug. Closing this as a duplicate of the older report; your 0.1.0 observation and the contrast between profiles are useful additional context.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both describe the same bug: turning on the show-characters setting doesn't update the status bar, which keeps showing only words until a restart or reload. B traces it to the setting being read only at activation.

rows.title: Word count off with double spaces
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. This is the same word-count defect tracked in https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/30, so we're closing this report as a duplicate of that older issue. The counter splits on individual spaces, causing each extra space to count as an empty word. Your additional example—three spaces adding two words—and the Note Stats 0.1.0 / VS Code 1.140 versions provide useful confirmation. The fix remains tracked there.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both report the status-bar word count rising by one for each extra space between words. B traces this to computeStats splitting on a single space, which explains A's symptom exactly.

rows.title: Character count setting not applied
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. This is the same defect as https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/4: `noteStats.showCharacters` is read only when the extension activates, so enabling it does not update the status bar until VS Code is restarted or the window is reloaded. Closing this report in favor of the older, better-described issue; your confirmation that a full restart also makes the character count appear is useful context for that work.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both report the noteStats.showCharacters setting having no effect until VS Code is restarted/reloaded, the same root cause: the setting is read once at activation and never re-read.

rows.title: Add grammar and spelling corrections [verification 20261019-issue15]
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the suggestion. Note Stats is focused on text statistics and small insertion helpers. Its [documented scope](https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/blob/main/vision.md#out-of-scope) explicitly excludes spelling and grammar corrections, rewriting, and features requiring a server or network access. We're closing this request as out of scope rather than expanding Note Stats into a cloud-backed writing assistant.
